ex: 我周末常常打网球。
I often play tennis at weekends.
他买了一个新的网球拍，想跟朋友比赛。
He bought a new tennis racket and wants to play a match with his friend.
use: Goes with the verb 打: 打网球, to play tennis.

m: **Soft** **and** smooth: light, sound or a voice that is **gentle**.
ex: 这个灯光很柔和。
This light is very soft.
她说话的声音柔和，大家都喜欢听。
She speaks in a gentle voice, and everyone likes to listen.
use: Used for light, colour, sound and voices, not for people's character.

m: **Wash** in the **bath**: **to bathe** or **take a shower**.
ex: 我每天晚上洗澡。
I take a shower every evening.
孩子玩了一天，得先洗澡再睡觉。
The kids played all day; they need to have a bath before bed.
use: A verb-object word: split it as 洗个澡, 洗了澡.

m: The **chief** people of an earlier **lifetime**: your **elders**.
ex: 过年要给长辈拜年。
At New Year you visit your elders.
在长辈面前说话要有礼貌。
You should speak politely in front of your elders.
use: The opposite is 晚辈, the younger generation.

m: **Store up** and **store up** again: money put away is **savings**.
ex: 他每个月都储蓄一点钱。
He saves a little money every month.
年轻人应该有储蓄的习惯。
Young people should get into the habit of saving.
use: More formal than 存钱, which is the everyday way to say it.

m: **Sad** and **cool**, like an empty winter street: **desolate** and **miserable**.
ex: 老人一个人过年，很凄凉。
The old man spent New Year alone; it was very bleak.
秋天的晚上，街上凄凉得很。
On autumn nights the street is very desolate.
use: Written and literary; describes scenes, lives and moods.

ex: 这条围巾是丝绸的。
This scarf is made of silk.
中国的丝绸很有名，很多外国人喜欢买。
Chinese silk is famous, and many foreigners like to buy it.
use: The cloth itself; 丝 alone is the thread.

m: A **letter** goes inside and you **seal** it: an **envelope**.
ex: 请把信放进信封里。
Please put the letter in the envelope.
我在信封上写了他的地址。
I wrote his address on the envelope.
use: Measure word 个.

m: The **former** one, who first **said** there was a wrong: the **plaintiff**.
ex: 原告今天没来法院。
The plaintiff did not come to court today.
法官让原告先说明情况。
The judge asked the plaintiff to explain first.
use: A legal term; the opposite is 被告, the defendant.

ex: 对不起，打扰一下。
Excuse me, sorry to bother you.
他在学习，别打扰他。
He is studying; don't disturb him.
use: 打扰了 is a polite set phrase when you interrupt or leave a host.

ex: 奶奶脸上有很多皱纹。
Grandma has a lot of wrinkles on her face.
他笑的时候，眼角会出现皱纹。
When he smiles, wrinkles appear at the corners of his eyes.
use: Measure word 道 or 条.

ex: 这个想法太荒谬了。
This idea is too absurd.
他说的话很荒谬，没人相信。
What he said was ridiculous; nobody believed it.
use: Stronger and more formal than 可笑.

ex: 这是一笔可观的收入。
This is a considerable income.
公司今年的利润相当可观。
The company's profit this year is quite impressive.
use: Mostly about amounts: money, numbers, income.

m: **Go out** on a **different** errand for work: **to go on a business trip**.
ex: 我下周要去上海出差。
Next week I'm going to Shanghai on a business trip.
他经常出差，很少在家。
He often travels for work and is rarely home.
use: Split as 出了一趟差 or 出过差.

m: The **extreme** point of the **north**: the **North Pole**.
ex: 北极非常冷。
The North Pole is extremely cold.
我很想去北极看一看北极熊。
I would love to go to the Arctic to see polar bears.
use: 南极 is the South Pole; 北极熊 is a polar bear.

m: Push back **contrary** to a **mixed-up** claim: **to refute**.
ex: 他马上反驳了我的话。
He immediately argued against what I said.
我想反驳，可是找不到理由。
I wanted to refute it, but couldn't find a reason.
use: Takes an object: 反驳别人的观点.

m: **Hard** in how you **carry out** your plans: **stubborn**.
ex: 我爸爸很固执。
My dad is very stubborn.
你别这么固执，听听别人的意见吧。
Don't be so stubborn; listen to other people's opinions.
use: Usually critical; 坚持 is the positive word for sticking to something.

ex: 这种水要过滤一下才能喝。
This kind of water must be filtered before drinking.
我家装了一个过滤器。
We installed a water filter at home.
use: 过滤器 is a filter; 过滤网 a filter screen.

m: Make water **clear** and **clear** again: **to clarify** a matter.
ex: 我想澄清一个问题。
I'd like to clarify one point.
公司很快发表声明澄清了这件事。
The company quickly issued a statement to clear the matter up.
use: Commonly means to clear up a misunderstanding or rumour.

ex: 在这件事上，我保持中立。
On this matter I stay neutral.
这个国家一直是中立国。
This country has always been a neutral country.
use: Often 保持中立, to remain neutral.

m: A **mistake** that makes things **differ**: an **error** in measuring.
ex: 这个误差不大。
This margin of error is small.
测量的时候总会有一点误差。
There is always a small error when you measure.
use: A technical word for measuring errors, not for wrong choices (错误).

ex: 这些工艺品都是手工做的。
These crafts are all handmade.
我在商店买了几件工艺品送给朋友。
I bought a few handicrafts at the shop as gifts for friends.
use: Measure word 件.

ex: 我女儿上幼儿园了。
My daughter has started kindergarten.
每天早上，妈妈送孩子去幼儿园。
Every morning, Mum takes the child to kindergarten.
use: Goes with 上 (to attend) and 送 (to take there).

ex: 奶奶喜欢编织毛衣。
Grandma likes knitting sweaters.
这个篮子是用竹子编织的。
This basket is woven from bamboo.
use: Also used figuratively: 编织梦想, to weave dreams.

m: A **record** **passed on** about a life: a **biography**.
ex: 我在看一本名人传记。
I'm reading a biography of a famous person.
他的传记很受读者欢迎。
His biography is very popular with readers.
use: Measure word 本 or 部.

ex: 他个子很高。
He is very tall.
我个子不高，可是跑得很快。
I'm not tall, but I run very fast.
use: Mostly in 个子高 or 个子矮; used for people.

ex: 这里不能抽烟。
You can't smoke here.
医生让他少抽烟，多运动。
The doctor told him to smoke less and exercise more.
use: Same as 吸烟, which is the word on signs: 禁止吸烟.

ex: 这根木头已经腐朽了。
This log has already rotted.
那座老房子的门窗都腐朽了。
The doors and windows of that old house have all rotted.
use: Also figurative, for corrupt old systems or ideas.

ex: 他们断绝了来往。
They broke off all contact.
两个国家断绝了外交关系。
The two countries severed diplomatic relations.
use: Goes with 关系, 来往, 联系.

m: It does **not** **want** to be **tight** or worrying: **it doesn't matter**.
ex: 不要紧，我自己来。
It's fine, I'll do it myself.
他的病不要紧，休息几天就好了。
His illness isn't serious; a few days' rest and he'll be fine.
use: Spoken; like 没关系 as a reply to an apology.

ex: 他说到这里停顿了一下。
He paused for a moment at this point.
读课文的时候，要注意停顿。
When reading a text aloud, pay attention to the pauses.
use: Often for pauses in speech or reading.

m: Take by the **neck** and **comprehend**: **to grasp** a meaning.
ex: 我终于领悟了这句话的意思。
I finally grasped the meaning of this sentence.
这个道理要自己慢慢领悟。
This kind of truth you have to come to understand slowly by yourself.
use: Deeper than 明白; for insights, not simple facts.

ex: 我中午想吃米饭。
I want to eat rice for lunch.
再来一碗米饭，谢谢。
Another bowl of rice, please.
use: Measure word 碗; 米 alone is uncooked rice.

ex: 字太小，我辨认不出来。
The writing is too small; I can't make it out.
她一眼就辨认出了自己的行李。
She identified her own luggage at a glance.
use: Often with 出: 辨认出, 辨认不出.

m: The **machine** of **growing** life: **vigour** and **hope of life**.
ex: 春天来了，到处充满生机。
Spring has come and everything is full of life.
这家老店又有了生机。
This old shop has come back to life.
use: Often 充满生机, full of vitality.

ex: 这些衣服是批发来的。
These clothes were bought wholesale.
批发的价格比零售便宜很多。
Wholesale prices are much cheaper than retail.
use: The opposite is 零售, retail.

ex: 你不用为他辩护。
You don't need to defend him.
律师在法庭上为他辩护。
The lawyer defended him in court.
use: Pattern: 为……辩护, to defend someone.

ex: 孩子们都爱吃零食。
Kids all love snacks.
晚上少吃零食，对身体好。
Eating fewer snacks in the evening is good for you.
use: Often 吃零食; it is uncountable.

ex: 这件事败坏了他的名声。
This affair ruined his reputation.
不要让个别人败坏了大家的风气。
Don't let a few people corrupt everyone's good habits.
use: Goes with 名声, 风气, 道德.

ex: 遇到危险要保持镇静。
In danger you must stay calm.
她很镇静地回答了警察的问题。
She calmly answered the police officer's questions.
use: Close to 冷静; 镇静 stresses not panicking.

ex: 他是一个值得信赖的人。
He is a trustworthy person.
老板很信赖她，把重要的工作都交给她。
The boss trusts her and gives her all the important work.
use: Stronger than 相信; 值得信赖 means trustworthy.

ex: 水在零度会凝固。
Water solidifies at zero degrees.
听到这个消息，空气好像凝固了。
At this news, the air seemed to freeze.
use: Also figurative: the atmosphere or a smile freezes.

ex: 我们坐出租车去吧。
Let's take a taxi.
这么晚了，很难打到出租车。
It's so late; it's hard to get a taxi.
use: Measure word 辆; 打车 means to take a taxi.

m: A **complicated** **body** of a **letter**: a **traditional Chinese character**.
ex: 台湾用繁体字。
Taiwan uses traditional characters.
我会看繁体字，但是不太会写。
I can read traditional characters, but I can't really write them.
use: The opposite is 简体字, simplified characters.

ex: 大家都赞美她的歌声。
Everyone praised her singing.
这首诗赞美了家乡的美丽。
This poem praises the beauty of the poet's hometown.
use: More formal than 夸; often in writing.

ex: 今年又是一个丰收年。
This is another year of good harvests.
农民们丰收了，脸上都是笑容。
The farmers had a big harvest and were all smiling.
use: Also figurative, for a rich result in sport or work.

m: Bring two sides together **and** **divide** the quarrel: **to reconcile**.
ex: 他们终于和解了。
They finally made up.
双方同意在法院外和解。
Both sides agreed to settle out of court.
use: For people, families or legal sides making peace.

m: A **staff** that helps you **turn** corners: a **crutch** or **walking stick**.
ex: 爷爷走路要用拐杖。
Grandpa needs a walking stick to walk.
他腿受伤了，只能拄着拐杖上班。
He hurt his leg and has to go to work on crutches.
use: Measure word 根; the verb is 拄, to lean on it.

ex: 杯子里还残留着一点咖啡。
There's still a little coffee left in the cup.
蔬菜上可能残留农药，要洗干净。
Vegetables may have pesticide on them; wash them well.
use: Often for traces of chemicals or smells.

ex: 有病要及早治疗。
If you are ill, get treatment early.
你最好及早做决定。
You'd better decide as early as you can.
use: Used before verbs; similar to 尽早.

ex: 他为了工作四处奔波。
He rushes around everywhere for work.
父母每天奔波，就是为了让孩子过得好。
Parents rush about every day just so their children can have a good life.
use: Often 四处奔波 or 为……奔波; suggests hard, tiring effort.

ex: 他家里发生了变故。
Something unexpected happened in his family.
经历了那次变故，她变得更坚强了。
After that misfortune, she became stronger.
use: Usually a bad event: an accident, death or disaster.

ex: 小鸟在天空中飞翔。
Little birds are soaring in the sky.
我梦见自己像鸟一样自由地飞翔。
I dreamed I was flying freely like a bird.
use: More poetic than 飞.

m: **Bow** and **seek** someone out: **to pay a visit**.
ex: 明天我去拜访一位老师。
Tomorrow I'm going to visit a teacher.
有时间我一定去您家拜访。
When I have time, I will certainly come and visit you at home.
use: Polite; for visiting people you respect, not places.

ex: 这个戒指上镶嵌着一颗钻石。
This ring is set with a diamond.
墙上镶嵌着很多彩色的小石头。
The wall is inlaid with many small coloured stones.
use: Often in the pattern 上镶嵌着…….

ex: 牛奶在冰箱里。
The milk is in the fridge.
把剩下的菜放进冰箱吧。
Put the leftovers in the fridge.
use: Measure word 台 or 个.

m: **Power** that people look up to like a **full moon**: **prestige**.
ex: 他在村里很有威望。
He has great prestige in the village.
这位老教授在学校里威望很高。
This old professor is highly respected at the university.
use: Goes with 有 and 高.

m: An **orderly** note of what is **important**: **minutes** of a meeting.
ex: 请把会议纪要发给我。
Please send me the meeting minutes.
她负责写这次会议的纪要。
She is responsible for writing up the minutes of this meeting.
use: Formal; mostly in 会议纪要.

ex: 他以前很努力，后来慢慢堕落了。
He used to work hard, but later slowly went downhill.
不要因为失败就让自己堕落。
Don't let yourself go to pieces because of one failure.
use: Strong moral word for a person going to the bad.

ex: 我很钦佩他的勇气。
I really admire his courage.
她一边工作一边照顾家庭，大家都很钦佩她。
She works while looking after her family, and everyone admires her.
use: Formal; similar to 佩服.

m: A **can** with a round **head**: a **tin**, **canned food**.
ex: 我买了几个水果罐头。
I bought a few cans of fruit.
罐头方便，可是不如新鲜的好吃。
Canned food is convenient, but not as tasty as fresh.
use: Means both the tin and its food; 罐头食品, canned food.

ex: 妈妈每天给我讲童话。
Mum tells me a fairy tale every day.
这个故事美得像童话一样。
This story is as beautiful as a fairy tale.
use: Goes with 讲 (tell) and 故事: 童话故事.

ex: 工作了一天，他感到很疲倦。
After a day's work, he felt very tired.
她脸上露出了疲倦的笑容。
A weary smile appeared on her face.
use: More written than 累.

ex: 他肆无忌惮地说别人的坏话。
He says bad things about others without any restraint.
这些人肆无忌惮地破坏环境，必须管一管。
These people are damaging the environment without restraint; someone has to stop them.
use: Strongly critical; usually before a verb with 地.

ex: 我们一起打扫房间吧。
Let's clean the room together.
周末我要打扫卫生，不能出去玩。
This weekend I have to do the cleaning, so I can't go out.
use: 打扫卫生 means to do the cleaning.

m: **Approach** and **face** the edge: **on the verge of**.
ex: 这种动物濒临灭绝。
This animal is on the verge of extinction.
那家公司已经濒临破产。
That company is already on the brink of bankruptcy.
use: Formal; goes with 灭绝, 破产, 崩溃.

ex: 他的态度很诚恳。
His attitude is very sincere.
她诚恳地向大家道歉。
She sincerely apologized to everyone.
use: For attitude, words and apologies.

ex: 他在梦里看见了魔鬼。
He saw a devil in his dream.
教练训练得很严，大家叫他“魔鬼教练”。
The coach trains us very hard, so everyone calls him the "devil coach".
use: 魔鬼训练 means very harsh training.

m: **Dredge** away your attention and **neglect** things: **to overlook**.
ex: 这是我的疏忽。
This was my oversight.
一时疏忽，他忘了锁门。
In a moment of carelessness, he forgot to lock the door.
use: Often 一时疏忽, a moment's carelessness.

ex: 他的字写得很端正。
His handwriting is very neat.
你要端正学习态度。
You need to correct your attitude to study.
use: As a verb it means to correct an attitude: 端正态度.

ex: 他喜欢钻研技术问题。
He likes delving into technical problems.
她多年钻研中医，经验很丰富。
She has studied Chinese medicine closely for years and is very experienced.
use: For focused study of a skill or subject.

ex: 门把手坏了。
The door handle is broken.
请抓好把手，车要开了。
Please hold the handle; the bus is about to leave.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 不要扰乱课堂秩序。
Don't disrupt the classroom.
噪音扰乱了我的思路。
The noise threw off my train of thought.
use: Goes with 秩序 (order) and 思路.

m: **Compare** one thing and **describe** it as another: a **metaphor**.
ex: 这个比喻很生动。
This metaphor is very vivid.
人们常把老师比喻成蜡烛。
People often compare teachers to candles.
use: Pattern: 把A比喻成B, to liken A to B.

m: Turn your **back** on the book and **read aloud**: **to recite from memory**.
ex: 老师让我们背诵这首诗。
The teacher asked us to recite this poem.
他能背诵很多唐诗。
He can recite many Tang poems from memory.
use: More formal than 背.

ex: 这些水果已经腐烂了。
This fruit has already gone rotten.
天气太热，地上的叶子很快就腐烂了。
It's so hot that the leaves on the ground rot quickly.
use: For food, plants and bodies; 腐败 is the word for corruption.

m: Climb **up** and **be** caught by a trick: **to be fooled**.
ex: 别上当，他在骗你。
Don't fall for it; he's lying to you.
我又上当了，买到的是假货。
I got fooled again; what I bought was fake.
use: Split as 上了他的当, fooled by him.

ex: 她对我很冷淡。
She is very cold towards me.
最近生意很冷淡，客人很少。
Business has been slow lately; there are few customers.
use: Pattern: 对……冷淡; also for slack business.

ex: 他嫉妒同事的成绩。
He is jealous of his colleague's success.
别嫉妒别人，努力做好自己。
Don't envy others; work on doing your own best.
use: Stronger and more negative than 羡慕, which is mild envy.

ex: 中国的土地很辽阔。
China's land is vast.
我们站在山上，看着辽阔的草原。
We stood on the mountain looking at the vast grassland.
use: For land, sea and sky.

ex: 这把刀很锋利。
This knife is very sharp.
小心，剪刀很锋利，别碰到手。
Careful, the scissors are sharp; don't cut your hand.
use: For blades; also figurative for sharp words.

ex: 他们见面握了握手。
They shook hands when they met.
比赛结束后，两个队员握手。
After the game, the two players shook hands.
use: Pattern: 跟/和……握手.

ex: 请填写配偶的姓名。
Please fill in your spouse's name.
他的配偶也在这家公司工作。
His spouse also works at this company.
use: Formal and legal; in speech say 爱人, 老公 or 老婆.

ex: 这件衣服太难看了。
This piece of clothing is so ugly.
听了这句话，他的脸色很难看。
When he heard this, his face darkened.
use: 脸色难看 means looking upset or ill.

m: A sound like teeth chattering: **to tremble**, **to shiver**.
ex: 他冷得直哆嗦。
He was shivering with cold.
她吓得打了个哆嗦。
She shivered with fright.
use: Spoken; 打哆嗦 means to give a shiver.

ex: 他的话让我很难堪。
His words embarrassed me.
当着这么多人被批评，她觉得非常难堪。
Being criticized in front of so many people made her feel very embarrassed.
use: Stronger than 不好意思.

ex: 这次比赛由一家公司赞助。
This competition is sponsored by a company.
我们在找赞助商。
We are looking for a sponsor.
use: 赞助商 means sponsor.

ex: 河面冻结了。
The river has frozen over.
银行冻结了他的账户。
The bank froze his account.
use: Figurative: frozen accounts, assets or prices.

ex: 我的键盘坏了。
My keyboard is broken.
他打字很快，手指在键盘上飞。
He types fast; his fingers fly over the keyboard.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 我们今天包饺子。
We're making dumplings today.
北方人过年一定要吃饺子。
In northern China, people always eat dumplings at New Year.
use: 包饺子 means to make (wrap) dumplings.

ex: 他是一个勤奋的学生。
He is a hardworking student.
只要勤奋学习，就一定会进步。
As long as you study hard, you'll certainly improve.
use: Often about study; similar to 努力 but written.

ex: 这里的自然条件得天独厚。
The natural conditions here are exceptionally good.
这座城市得天独厚，有山有海。
This city is especially blessed, with both mountains and sea.
use: Usually about places, conditions or talent.

ex: 妈妈拥抱了我。
Mum hugged me.
他们在机场紧紧地拥抱在一起。
They hugged each other tightly at the airport.
use: More formal than 抱.

ex: 在这个问题上，我不会让步。
On this issue I won't give way.
双方都做了让步，问题终于解决了。
Both sides made concessions, and the problem was finally solved.
use: Split as 让了一步.

ex: 他是一个平凡的人。
He is an ordinary person.
她在平凡的工作中做出了不平凡的成绩。
She achieved extraordinary results in an ordinary job.
use: Neutral or warm; 普通 is plainer.

ex: 狐狸很狡猾。
Foxes are cunning.
那个人非常狡猾，你要小心。
That person is very sly; be careful.
use: Negative; often said of foxes.

ex: 请到柜台付钱。
Please pay at the counter.
酒店的柜台二十四小时有人。
The hotel's front desk is staffed 24 hours.
use: Measure word 个.

ex: 双方签了合作意向书。
Both sides signed a letter of intent to cooperate.
他有出国留学的意向。
He intends to study abroad.
use: Formal; 意向书 is a letter of intent.

m: **Breaking** off and **continuing**, again and again: **off and on**.
ex: 雨断断续续地下了一天。
It rained on and off all day.
他断断续续地讲了事情的经过。
He told what happened in bits and pieces.
use: Usually before a verb with 地.

m: **Extinguish** and **put out**: to **go out**, of a fire or light.
ex: 火已经熄灭了。
The fire has gone out.
大楼里的灯一个一个熄灭了。
The lights in the building went out one by one.
use: Can be with or without an object.

ex: 他向我打招呼。
He said hello to me.
你走之前跟我打招呼。
Let me know before you leave.
use: Also means to give notice. Pattern: 跟/向……打招呼.

ex: 门和墙之间有一点空隙。
There's a small gap between the door and the wall.
他利用工作的空隙学英语。
He studies English in the gaps between work.
use: Also for spare moments of time.

ex: 他推辞了半天，最后还是收下了礼物。
He declined for a long time, but in the end he accepted the gift.
朋友请我吃饭，我不好推辞。
My friend invited me to dinner; I couldn't really say no.
use: Polite refusing of invitations, gifts, jobs.

ex: 数据有一点偏差。
The data is slightly off.
我们对这个问题的理解出现了偏差。
There was a mismatch in how we understood this problem.
use: Often 出现偏差, a deviation appears.

m: **Idle** and **slow** with a guest: **to slight**, **to neglect**.
ex: 对不起，怠慢了。
Sorry, I haven't looked after you properly.
客人来了，不能怠慢。
When guests come, you mustn't neglect them.
use: 怠慢了 is a polite thing a host says.

m: A picture that is **similar** and **resembles** you: a **portrait**.
ex: 墙上挂着一幅肖像。
A portrait hangs on the wall.
这位画家给我画了一张肖像。
The artist painted my portrait.
use: Measure word 幅 or 张; 肖像权, the right to one's image.

ex: 这是杂交水稻。
This is hybrid rice.
科学家把两种花杂交，得到了新品种。
Scientists crossed two kinds of flower and got a new variety.
use: A biology and farming word.

m: An **idea** that **exists** in your mind: **to care about**, **to mind**.
ex: 别人说什么，我不在意。
I don't care what other people say.
他很在意自己的外表。
He cares a lot about his appearance.
use: Most often negative: 不在意, 别在意.

ex: 战争摧残了这个城市。
The war ravaged this city.
熬夜会摧残你的身体。
Staying up late ruins your health.
use: Strong; for health, people, flowers, culture.

ex: 她一个人把孩子抚养大。
She raised the child on her own.
父母有抚养孩子的责任。
Parents have a duty to bring up their children.
use: Pattern: 把孩子抚养大.

ex: 我们要勇于承认错误。
We must have the courage to admit our mistakes.
年轻人应该勇于尝试新事物。
Young people should be bold in trying new things.
use: Always followed by a verb; formal.

ex: 我昨天晚上失眠了。
I couldn't sleep last night.
压力太大，他经常失眠。
He is under so much pressure that he often can't sleep.
use: Intransitive; 失眠症 is insomnia as an illness.

ex: 警察在机场严密戒备。
The police are on high alert at the airport.
他对陌生人有很强的戒备心。
He is very wary of strangers.
use: 戒备心 means wariness.

ex: 这种做法太卑鄙了。
This is a despicable way to act.
他用卑鄙的手段得到了这个位置。
He got this position by underhand means.
use: Very strong criticism.

ex: 这个商标很有名。
This trademark is very famous.
公司注册了自己的商标。
The company registered its own trademark.
use: 注册商标, registered trademark.

ex: 他死后被埋葬在家乡。
After he died, he was buried in his hometown.
这里埋葬着很多战士。
Many soldiers are buried here.
use: For burying the dead; 埋 alone is for any burying.

ex: 这个地区人口稠密。
This area is densely populated.
城市里的房子越来越稠密。
Houses in the city are getting more and more crowded.
use: Mostly in 人口稠密.

ex: 汉语有四个声调。
Chinese has four tones.
他的声调不太准，要多练习。
His tones aren't very accurate; he needs more practice.
use: In learning Chinese, the four tones of syllables.

ex: 我买了一张音乐光盘。
I bought a music CD.
现在用光盘的人越来越少了。
Fewer and fewer people use discs these days.
use: Measure word 张.

ex: 大自然真奇妙。
Nature is truly wonderful.
这是一次奇妙的旅行。
This was a magical trip.
use: Positive surprise; stronger than 有意思.

ex: 他应邀参加了晚会。
He attended the party at their invitation.
这位作家应邀来我们学校讲课。
This writer was invited to give a talk at our school.
use: Formal; often 应邀参加 or 应邀出席.

ex: 牙膏用完了。
The toothpaste has run out.
我去超市买一支牙膏。
I'm going to the supermarket to buy a tube of toothpaste.
use: Measure word 支 or 管; 牙刷 is a toothbrush.

ex: 不得了，着火了！
Oh no, there's a fire!
今天热得不得了。
It's extremely hot today.
use: After 得 it means extremely: 高兴得不得了.

ex: 他在北京做生意。
He does business in Beijing.
做生意要讲信用。
In business you must keep your word.
use: Pattern: 跟……做生意.

ex: 我爱吃巧克力。
I love eating chocolate.
她送了我一盒巧克力。
She gave me a box of chocolates.
use: Measure word 块 or 盒.

ex: 他的房间很简陋。
His room is very basic.
学校的条件虽然简陋，但是老师很好。
The school is poorly equipped, but the teachers are good.
use: For rooms, buildings and equipment.

ex: 这是我的隐私。
That's my private business.
我们要尊重别人的隐私。
We should respect other people's privacy.
use: Often 保护隐私 or 尊重隐私.

ex: 你的想法太幼稚了。
Your thinking is too childish.
他都三十岁了，做事还这么幼稚。
He's thirty, but he still acts so childishly.
use: Critical; 幼稚园 is the Taiwan word for kindergarten.

ex: 没有人逼迫你。
Nobody is forcing you.
他被逼迫签了合同。
He was forced to sign the contract.
use: More formal than 逼.

ex: 这家公司做汽车租赁。
This company does car rentals.
这些设备是租赁来的。
This equipment is leased.
use: Formal and business; 租 is everyday.

m: **Accuse falsely** and dig a **pitfall**: **to frame** someone.
ex: 有人诬陷他偷了钱。
Someone framed him for stealing money.
我没做，你别诬陷我！
I didn't do it; don't frame me!
use: Strong and legal-sounding.

ex: 田野里开满了花。
The fields are full of flowers.
我们走在田野上，看到了很多牛羊。
We walked through the fields and saw many cows and sheep.
use: Rural and a little literary.

ex: 蜜蜂在花上飞。
Bees are flying over the flowers.
他被蜜蜂蜇了一下。
He got stung by a bee.
use: Measure word 只.

m: Carry the **crime** of a **burden** you dropped: **to let down**.
ex: 我不会辜负你的期望。
I won't let you down.
他辜负了父母的一片好心。
He let down his parents' good intentions.
use: Objects: 期望, 信任, 好意.

m: The **type** of event when the **curtain** **opens**: an **opening ceremony**.
ex: 开幕式晚上七点开始。
The opening ceremony starts at 7pm.
很多人在电视上看了奥运会开幕式。
Many people watched the Olympic opening ceremony on TV.
use: The opposite is 闭幕式, closing ceremony.

ex: 我隐约听到有人在哭。
I faintly heard someone crying.
远处隐约可以看到一座山。
A mountain can just be seen in the distance.
use: Often 隐约听到, 隐约看见.

ex: 比赛延期了。
The match has been postponed.
因为下雨，运动会延期到下周。
Because of rain, the sports day was put off until next week.
use: Often 延期到 + time.

ex: 我删除了那张照片。
I deleted that photo.
请不要随便删除文件。
Please don't delete files carelessly.
use: The computer word for delete.

ex: 这部小说构思很巧妙。
This novel is cleverly conceived.
他花了一年构思这个故事。
He spent a year working out this story.
use: For stories, designs and plans.

ex: 帮助朋友是理所当然的。
Of course you help your friends.
他觉得别人帮他是理所当然的。
He takes it for granted that others will help him.
use: 觉得……理所当然 means to take for granted.

ex: 孩子的心很纯洁。
Children have pure hearts.
他们之间是纯洁的友谊。
What they have is a pure friendship.
use: Moral purity, not clean water (干净).

ex: 你对他有偏见。
You are prejudiced against him.
我们不应该带着偏见看人。
We shouldn't judge people with prejudice.
use: Pattern: 对……有偏见.

m: **Boil** and **gallop**: **to boil**, **to boil over** with feeling.
ex: 水沸腾了。
The water is boiling.
听到这个好消息，全场沸腾了。
At this good news, the whole place erupted.
use: Figurative for crowds and excitement.

ex: 他家的生意很兴旺。
His family's business is thriving.
祝你们家人丁兴旺！
May your family grow and prosper!
use: For business, families and towns.

m: A single **sheet** for a **bed**: a **bed sheet**.
ex: 我把床单洗了。
I washed the bed sheet.
酒店每天换床单。
The hotel changes the sheets every day.
use: Measure word 条 or 张.

ex: 他吃坏了东西，开始腹泻。
He ate something bad and got diarrhoea.
腹泻的时候要多喝水。
When you have diarrhoea, drink plenty of water.
use: Medical; in speech say 拉肚子.

m: Be **pregnant** and **have children**: **to give birth to**, to nurture.
ex: 母亲孕育了生命。
A mother gives birth to life.
这片土地孕育了古老的文明。
This land gave rise to an ancient civilization.
use: Often figurative: lands, cultures, ideas.

ex: 中国人忌讳数字四。
Chinese people avoid the number four.
在老人面前说“死”是一种忌讳。
Saying "death" in front of old people is taboo.
use: Both a noun and a verb.

ex: 他每天辛苦挣钱。
He works hard every day to earn money.
挣钱不容易，要好好花。
Earning money isn't easy, so spend it well.
use: Spoken; same as 赚钱.

ex: 请改正这些错误。
Please correct these mistakes.
有了错误就要马上改正。
When you make a mistake, put it right at once.
use: Usually with 错误 or 缺点.

ex: 祝你发财！
May you prosper!
他做生意发财了，买了一座大房子。
He got rich in business and bought a big house.
use: 恭喜发财 is a New Year greeting.

ex: 上课的时候可以录音吗？
Can I record during class?
我把这段录音发给你。
I'll send you this recording.
use: Measure word 段 for a recording.

ex: 他有一份体面的工作。
He has a respectable job.
穿得体面一点，今天要见客户。
Dress a bit smartly; we're meeting clients today.
use: Close to 面子; about looking respectable.

ex: 他在比赛中得了亚军。
He came second in the competition.
我们队去年是亚军，今年想拿冠军。
Our team came second last year; this year we want to win.
use: 冠军 first, 亚军 second, 季军 third.

m: **Pour** tea and **pour** wine, carefully weighing each cup: **to deliberate**.
ex: 这个问题要好好斟酌一下。
This question needs careful thought.
他斟酌了很久，才写下这句话。
He weighed it up for a long time before writing this sentence.
use: Formal; often about choosing words.

ex: 我们要先筛选简历。
We need to screen the CVs first.
经过三轮筛选，只剩下十个人。
After three rounds of selection, only ten people were left.
use: For choosing among many candidates or items.

ex: 她很喜欢唱歌。
She really likes singing.
周末我们去唱歌吧！
Let's go to karaoke at the weekend!
use: A verb-object word: 唱一首歌. 去唱歌 often means karaoke.

m: Standing on the **root** of something: **based on**, **in line with**.
ex: 我们本着公平的原则处理这件事。
We will handle this based on the principle of fairness.
本着对顾客负责的态度，我们会检查每一件产品。
Out of responsibility to our customers, we check every product.
use: Formal; with 原则, 精神, 态度.

ex: 这两张图片重叠在一起了。
These two pictures overlap.
这两个部门的工作有很多重叠。
The work of these two departments overlaps a lot.
use: Also the grammar word for reduplication (看看).

ex: 这个城市里新旧建筑并存。
Old and new buildings coexist in this city.
机会和挑战并存。
Opportunities and challenges exist side by side.
use: Formal.

ex: 每天的生活很单调。
Daily life is very monotonous.
房间的颜色太单调了，加点花吧。
The colours in the room are too dull; add some flowers.
use: For life, colours, sounds.

m: The **joint** of the year when the **country** **celebrates**: **National Day**.
ex: 国庆节放七天假。
We get seven days off for National Day.
国庆节的时候，很多人出去旅游。
During National Day, many people go travelling.
use: October 1st in the PRC.

m: **Noisy** words built up like a **frame**: **to quarrel**.
ex: 他们又吵架了。
They quarrelled again.
我不想跟你吵架。
I don't want to argue with you.
use: Pattern: 跟……吵架; split as 吵了一架.

m: **Supervise** and hurry in a **short** time: **to urge on**.
ex: 妈妈督促我做作业。
Mum keeps after me to do my homework.
老师经常督促学生多读书。
The teacher often urges the students to read more.
use: Pattern: 督促某人做某事.

m: From a **hazy** mind, **so** suddenly a **big** **understanding**: **to suddenly realize**.
ex: 听了他的解释，我恍然大悟。
After his explanation, it suddenly dawned on me.
她看到照片才恍然大悟，原来他们早就认识。
Only when she saw the photo did she realize they had known each other all along.
use: Often followed by 原来…….

m: **Mix** things until **confused**: **to confuse**, to mix up.
ex: 这两个字很容易混淆。
These two characters are easy to mix up.
不要混淆这两个概念。
Don't confuse these two concepts.
use: Also 混淆视听, to mislead the public.

m: **Pressed from both sides** and **mixed**: **to be mixed in with**.
ex: 他说中文时夹杂着英文。
He mixes English into his Chinese.
风声里夹杂着孩子的笑声。
The children's laughter mingled with the sound of the wind.
use: Often 夹杂着.

ex: 我家养了一只兔子。
We keep a rabbit at home.
兔子跑得很快，我追不上。
The rabbit runs fast; I can't catch it.
use: Measure word 只.

ex: 老师，再见！
Goodbye, teacher!
我们明天再见吧。
Let's meet again tomorrow.
use: The standard goodbye; 拜拜 is casual.

ex: 这条裙子很漂亮。
This skirt is very pretty.
天气热了，她穿上了裙子。
It has got hot, so she put on a skirt.
use: Measure word 条; covers dresses too.

ex: 新学期开始了。
The new term has started.
这个学期我选了五门课。
This semester I chose five courses.
use: 上学期 last term, 下学期 next term.

ex: 快走吧，要不然就迟到了。
Let's go quickly, otherwise we'll be late.
你多穿点，要不然会感冒的。
Put on more clothes, or else you'll catch a cold.
use: Same as 不然 and 要不; spoken.

ex: 我有一双棕色的鞋。
I have a pair of brown shoes.
她的头发是棕色的。
Her hair is brown.
use: 咖啡色 is another everyday word for brown.

ex: 他有偷东西的嫌疑。
He is suspected of stealing.
警察已经排除了他的嫌疑。
The police have cleared him of suspicion.
use: 嫌疑人 is a suspect.

m: **Wind** from the **platform** of the sea: a **typhoon**.
ex: 明天有台风。
There's a typhoon tomorrow.
因为台风，航班都取消了。
Because of the typhoon, the flights were all cancelled.
use: Also means stage presence: 台风很好.

ex: 众所周知，抽烟对身体不好。
As everyone knows, smoking is bad for your health.
这是一个众所周知的事实。
This is a well-known fact.
use: Formal; often starts a sentence.

ex: 我们要辩证地看问题。
We should look at problems from all sides.
这本书讲了辩证的思想方法。
This book is about dialectical thinking.
use: Formal; 辩证地看 means to see both sides.

m: A **touch** for the **heart** before a meal: **pastries**, **snacks**.
ex: 我们吃点心吧。
Let's have some pastries.
广东人早上喜欢喝茶吃点心。
Cantonese people like to have tea and dim sum in the morning.
use: Includes dim sum.

m: **Push** the buttons and **strike** them: **to dial** a number.
ex: 请拨打这个电话号码。
Please call this number.
有问题可以拨打客服电话。
If you have problems, you can call customer service.
use: Formal; in speech say 打电话.

ex: 今天气压很低。
The air pressure is low today.
山上气压低，水不到一百度就开了。
Air pressure is low on the mountain, so water boils below 100 degrees.
use: Science and weather word.

ex: 他穿着一件白衬衫。
He's wearing a white shirt.
这件衬衫太小了，换一件大的吧。
This shirt is too small; change it for a bigger one.
use: Measure word 件.

ex: 我们一起合影吧。
Let's take a photo together.
这是我们全班的合影。
This is our class photo.
use: Pattern: 跟……合影; split as 合个影.

ex: 吃饭要慢慢咀嚼。
Chew your food slowly.
这句话值得我们好好咀嚼。
This sentence is worth thinking over carefully.
use: Written; spoken is 嚼.

ex: 海上的波浪很大。
The waves on the sea are big.
她的头发像波浪一样。
Her hair is wavy.
use: 浪 alone is common in speech.

ex: 我今天没有胃口。
I have no appetite today.
这道菜很合我的胃口。
This dish is very much to my taste.
use: 合……的胃口 means to suit one's taste.

ex: 对不起，我迟到了。
Sorry, I'm late.
明天开会，千万别迟到。
There's a meeting tomorrow; whatever you do, don't be late.
use: Intransitive: say 上课迟到, not 迟到上课.

m: **Not** **ashamed** to bear the name: **worthy of being**.
ex: 你不愧是我们的老师！
You really are worthy of being our teacher!
他不愧是冠军，跑得真快。
He's a true champion; he runs so fast.
use: Usually 不愧是 or 不愧为.

ex: 我们一起打乒乓球吧。
Let's play table tennis together.
乒乓球在中国非常受欢迎。
Table tennis is very popular in China.
use: Goes with 打.

ex: 医生告诫他不要喝酒。
The doctor warned him not to drink.
父母常常告诫我们要诚实。
Our parents often told us to be honest.
use: Formal; from someone older or senior.

ex: 我们去公园散步吧。
Let's go for a walk in the park.
吃完晚饭，爷爷都要出去散散步。
After dinner, Grandpa always goes out for a little walk.
use: Split as 散散步, 散一会儿步.

m: **Without** anything to **depend on** but tricks: a **rascal**.
ex: 他是个无赖。
He's a scoundrel.
别跟他耍无赖了，快把钱还给我。
Stop playing the rogue and give me back my money.
use: 耍无赖 means to act shamelessly.

ex: 政府今年有财政赤字。
The government has a budget deficit this year.
公司连续两年出现赤字。
The company has been in deficit for two years in a row.
use: Opposite: 盈余, surplus.

ex: 你会跳舞吗？
Can you dance?
她每天晚上去广场跳舞。
She goes to dance in the square every evening.
use: Pattern: 跟……跳舞; split as 跳个舞.

m: Beat a **drum** to get people **moving**: **to urge**, **to stir up**.
ex: 是他鼓动大家去的。
It was he who got everyone to go.
别听他的鼓动。
Don't listen to his urging.
use: Can be good or bad; 煽动 is always bad.

m: Keep watch at the **pass** and **shine** a light on someone: **to look after**.
ex: 请多关照！
Please look after me!
谢谢你对我的关照。
Thank you for looking out for me.
use: 请多关照 is said on meeting new colleagues.

ex: 这个设计很新颖。
This design is very original.
他的想法新颖，大家都很喜欢。
His ideas are fresh, and everyone likes them.
use: For ideas, designs and styles.

ex: 这首曲子很好听。
This tune is lovely.
她弹了一首钢琴曲子。
She played a piano piece.
use: Measure word 首.

ex: 喝点开水吧。
Have some boiled water.
小心，开水很烫！
Careful, the boiling water is very hot!
use: Can be hot or cooled boiled water.
